_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — copy this file to athlete.json and fill in your values. config.py reads athlete.json on import and derives paces/zones. Never edit config.py directly.
_setup: 1) cp athlete.example.json athlete.json  2) Fill in your VDOT (from a recent race) and LTHR (from a Friel field test)  3) Run: .venv/bin/python3.13 ../tests/test_suite.py
name: Your Name
_vdot_help: Use a recent race result at vdoto2.com. Update after every race or TT — never from training pace alone.
_lthr_help: Lactate Threshold Heart Rate. Run a Friel 30-min TT; avg HR of last 20 min ≈ LTHR. Must equal rhr + int(hrr * hr_zone_hrr_pct.T) for zones to be consistent.
_rhr_help: Resting HR (morning, before getting up). Check Garmin app 7-day avg.
_mhr_help: Max HR. Use peak HR from a hard interval session or hill sprint.
_pain_status_help: none | mild | moderate — persisted injury state, read as the default for every tool's --pain flag (daily_brief.py, session_prescriber.py) so downgrades apply automatically without re-typing --pain on every call. Update this the moment an injury is confirmed or resolved.
_training_days_help: How many days/week you actually RUN (not counting a separate strength day). Used by training_planner.py to size session distribution — fewer days compress to 1 quality day, more days keep 2 quality + easy spread.
_rest_days_help: Lowercase day names with ZERO training (no run, no strength). training_planner.py marks these REST.
_strength_day_help: Lowercase day name for strength/conditioning (non-running, not a rest day). Omit if you don't lift.
_zones_note: HR zones are derived automatically by config.py from lthr/rhr/mhr above. Do not edit hr_zone_hrr_pct unless you know what you are doing.
_paces_note: Paces (sec/km) derived from VDOT 40 Jack Daniels table. Update after changing vdot — or let config.py recompute automatically if your version supports it.

vdot_paces_sec._help: Jack Daniels VDOT 40 paces. Replace with values from your VDOT at vdoto2.com.

nutrition_products._comment: Na content of your electrolyte products in mg per unit. Field names below (prevo_na_mg, aminovital_na_mg) are just the original developer's products — the NAMES don't matter, put YOUR product's numbers in these same two fields regardless of brand (e.g. SaltStick Caps, Precision Fuel & Hydration, Maurten, GU Roctane, SIS — check each product's own label for its actual Na mg).

quality_nutrition._comment: Pre-run protocol for quality sessions (T/I/R, 60-80 min). Edit to match your products.

race_day_nutrition._comment: Race morning pre-race protocol. Adjust timing and products to your stomach.

long_run_nutrition._comment: Split protocol for treadmill vs outdoor. Update sweat_rate_L_hr from a weigh-in test (pre/post weight + fluid consumed).
